svg.title: Different tool lengths at the same tip level
svg.desc: A shorter tool and a longer tool have tips at the same example surface. The holder for the longer tool is drawn higher. This illustrates why the head coordinate must account for tool length; it is not a probing procedure.

g.text: The tool tip and the controlled head are different points
Conceptual side view — no dimensions or machine-axis directions are prescribed.
can give the same tip level.
Tool measurement and work-zero setting have separate purposes. Use their approved procedures.
